answer:
**Answer: Downregulation of metabolic genes primarily drives the metabolic effects of CBD in CRC cells.**

Using differential expression (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.5) on the CBD_IC50 (group 7) vs DMSO vehicle (group 3) contrast, the response is strongly down-skewed (569 down vs 297 up; 65.7% down), and the verifiable canonical metabolic genes move consistently downward: glycolysis/glucose-uptake and lipid/cholesterol-biosynthesis genes (GAPDH, PGK1, SLC2A1/GLUT1, FASN, HMGCR, SREBF2, MYC) are significantly down-regulated, while only stress/metabolic regulators (HIF1A, MTOR) and LDHB shift up. The sensitivity contrast (CBD+serum-starvation vs DMSO+starvation) reproduces and strengthens this (FASN −1.25, PGK1 −1.14, HMGCR −1.03, GAPDH −0.62 log2FC, all padj < 0.05).

**Execution summary (all steps executed; see analysis_full.py)**
- Filtering: 63,677 genes → 27,494 retained (27,954 all-zero + 8,229 with <10 total counts removed). Library sizes 8.2–51.9M; DESeq2-style median-of-ratios size factors computed per contrast.
- Model: DESeq2-equivalent NB GLM implemented in Python (no R/network available): Poisson fit → gene-wise dispersion MLE → MoM-based trended dispersion → MAP shrinkage (Cauchy prior) → Wald test → BH padj. Dispersion validated against method-of-moments (estimates ≈ 0.8× MoM, mildly conservative); permutation calibration (12 label permutations, size factors recomputed per perm): median null padj<0.05 rate 1.7% (nominal 5%), heavy tail to 12.7% in 2/12 perms — a caveat for extreme p-values with 3v3 replicates.
- DE results: primary 297 up / 569 down; sensitivity 1189 up / 1548 down (2,323/2,472 genes with all-zero counts in one group excluded).
- Step B (direction counting, primary evidence): 21/30 near-certain canonical metabolic/context genes analyzable. Significantly changed (padj<0.05, any LFC) metabolic genes: primary 8 DOWN (PGK1 −0.53, FASN −0.44, SLC2A1 −0.42, GAPDH −0.30, HK1 −0.29, HMGCR −0.25, SREBF2 −0.08, MYC −0.11) vs 2 UP (HIF1A +0.27, MTOR +0.19); sensitivity 9 DOWN vs 3 UP (LDHB +2.03 the only metabolic-pathway gene up). At the required thresholds (|log2FC|>0.5 & padj<0.05): PGK1 DOWN in both contrasts; FASN, HMGCR, GAPDH DOWN in sensitivity. Housekeeping check: ACTB log2FC −0.01, padj 0.93 (stable, as expected).
- Step C (GO BP): full over-representation analysis was NOT possible offline — exhaustive search found no GO/Ensembl annotation resource in the environment and all network egress is blocked (DNS fail; raw-IP unreachable). Term counts on the verifiable universe (N=21): the only term hit is GO:0006096 glycolytic process → PGK1, in the DOWN set; the universe is far too sparse for valid Fisher enrichment (per-term K = 1–4), so GO evidence is supporting-only and directional counting carries the conclusion.

**Stated limitations/assumptions** (also embedded in summary.json): (1) group→condition mapping (7=CBD_IC50, 3=DMSO vehicle) is inferred from labels, not documented; (2) gene-symbol assignments rest on canonical stable Ensembl IDs and could not be independently verified offline — genes absent from the matrix (HK2, PKM, LDHA, PDK1, IDH2, BCL2; ALDOA/ENO1/CASP3 with 1–2 total counts) were excluded and reported as an annotation gap; (3) no full GO BP enrichment was possible; (4) DESeq2-equivalent re-implementation in Python, not R DESeq2; (5) n=3 per group limits dispersion precision (calibration tail noted above).
